items.title: Restless Legs in Pregnancy Triples Depression Risk
items.snippet: Pregnant women who develop restless legs syndrome during their third trimester face three times the risk of perinatal depression compared to those without the sleep movement disorder. A study of over 2,400 mothers highlights the urgent need for late-gestation sleep screening.

items.title: ADHD Linked to 70% Higher All-Cause Mortality Risk
items.snippet: A meta-analysis of 16M people links ADHD to a 70% higher all-cause mortality risk, while ADHD medication was tied to a 25% lower risk of premature death.
